resources.string: Cannot preview Android audio stream %1$d on this device.

Navigation defaults to 14, the stream BYD uses for guidance. 0 = automatic routing; values 1–20 are legacy stream IDs the head unit may route to its vehicle outputs. Tap a value to preview it. Changes apply on reconnect.
CarPlay media claims audio focus. If sound disappears while enabled (some head units handle focus badly), turn it off. Changes apply on reconnect.

Navigation announcements reduce CarPlay music volume instead of playing straight over it. Both tracks belong to this app, so the adjustment is made here, not through audio focus. Some head units already do this in their own mixer. Changes apply on reconnect.
